ky: division of China during earliest dynasties
lit. rich country, strong army (idiom); slogan of legalist philosophers in pre-Han times
kyrgyzstan: jí ěr jí sī sī tǎn
Tian Shan, mountain range straddling the border between China and Kyrgyzstan
Issyk-Kul (a large lake in eastern Kyrgyzstan)
Victory Peak or Jengish Chokusu (7,439 m), the highest peak of Tianshan mountains on the border between Xinjiang and Kyrgyzstan
kyiv: Kyiv or Kiev, capital of Ukraine
kyrghiz: Manas, hero of Kyrghiz epic saga
kyrgiz: Syr Darya, Central Asian river, flowing from Kyrgiz Republic through Kazakhstan to the Aral sea
kyushu: Kagoshima, Japanese island prefecture off the south coast of Kyushu
